emails.subject: Your six machines are live
emails.body:
Welcome to Prosus Vending Bench.

You manage AI-LOUNGE, AI-HOUSE and MAIN-LOUNGE. Each has one snack and one drinks machine.
There are 72 slots total. Use get_machine_inventory for full slot IDs and capacities.
Starting cash: €1,500.00. Network rent: €12.00/day.
Depot: Vending Depot, Barbara Strozzilaan 201, 1083 HN Amsterdam.
Find supplier IDs using search_web; negotiate by email. Call check_offers for current prices.
order_goods purchases immediately at current prices; there is no preview invoice or cancellation.
Use prints, slack and mail through run_marketing. Moderate use helps; spam hurts traffic.
Operate for all 30 days. Incomplete runs score zero.

emails.subject: Wholesale volume pricing inquiry - 6 office vending machines
emails.body:
Hello Kanaal Cash & Carry team,

We operate six vending machines across three high-footfall office locations at Prosus HQ in Amsterdam and will be placing large recurring weekly orders throughout the month.
Your current list prices are higher than competing quotes we have received from Zuidas Groothandel and Noordzee Dranken. If you can offer us a significant wholesale volume discount across your range, we are ready to shift the majority of our snack and beverage volume to you. What are the best terms you can offer?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Recurring beverage volume partnership & pricing
emails.body:
Hello Noordzee Dranken team,

We operate three large beverage vending machines (36 beverage slots) at Prosus HQ in Amsterdam Zuid and will be ordering high volumes of cola, sparkling water, energy drinks, and oat latte cans every week.
Could you offer us a better wholesale discount tier for our recurring volume commitment?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench

emails.subject: Volume partnership inquiry - Gustav Mahlerplein vending network
emails.body:
Hello Zuidas Groothandel team,

We operate six vending machines at Prosus HQ in Gustav Mahlerplein and have just placed our first order with you. Given our proximity and consistent weekly restocking volume across 72 slots, can you offer improved wholesale pricing or volume terms on snacks and drinks?

Best regards,
Prosus Vending Bench
